title: A material-agnostic platform to probe spin-phonon interactions using high-overtone bulk acoustic wave resonators
summary: Spin-phonon interactions have a dual role in emerging spin-based quantum technologies. While they can be a limitation to device performance through decoherence, they also serve as a critical resource for coherent spin control, detection, and the realization of spin-based quantum networks. However, their direct characterization remains a challenge and is usually material-dependent.
